question: Where and to whom does the devotee acknowledge having offered worship?
premises: Worships were performed by the devotee
They were offered to the lord of the world
inference: The devotee acknowledges worship offered to the lord of the world at Maṇikūṭa.
uncertainties: The sentence continues in the next verse.
plain_english: Whatever worships I have performed for you at Maṇikūṭa, O lord of the world...
